items.title: Ijuí (RS) Works & infrastructure procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #13
items.en_title: Ijuí (RS) Works & infrastructure procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #13
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Ijuí (RS) is procuring works, repairs or infrastructure services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 990,000; proposals close Nov 25, 15:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
